a.xlink:title: Final-byte dispatcher for the assembled CSI sequence.
CSI G (CHA) / CSI d (VPA) — absolute column or row positioning. Both are 1-based on the wire and clam...
CSI H / f — cursor position. Row and column are 1-based on the wire; the cell grid is 0-based,...
CSI A/B/C/D — relative cursor motion, clamped to the grid edge.
CSI ?N h / CSI ?N l — DEC private mode set/reset.
CSI X (ECH) — erase Pn chars at the cursor, no cursor move.
CSI J (ED) — erase in display (mode 0/1/2).
CSI K (EL) — erase in line (mode 0/1/2).
CSI b (REP) — repeat the last emitted codepoint Pn times.
CSI u — restore cursor saved by CSI s.
CSI s — save cursor (paired with CSI u).
CSI m — Select Graphic Rendition. Defined in sgr.c; called from csi.c's handle_csi switch.
Convenience for cursor-movement sequences: parse first param, default to 1 when missing or zero.
Parse up to maxn decimal parameters from esc_buf into pv.
Apply one parsed DEC private-mode number with set/reset polarity.
Parse the DEC private-mode param list out of esc_buf.
Blank the inclusive rectangle [(y0, x0), (y1, x1)] using the current SGR fg/bg.
Render the cell at the live grid position (col, row).
Emit one codepoint at the cell cursor and advance, wrapping or scrolling as needed.
Commit cp with the live SGR state into c and either mark dirty (batch mode) or blit immediately.
Wrap the cursor to the next line, scrolling the grid when at the bottom.
Update cur_attr from a single-param attribute code (bold, italic, …, or the corresponding 21/22/23/… ...
Update cur_fg / cur_bg from a single-param colour code (default, 30..37, 40..47, 90....
Handle the multi-param extended colour forms 38;5;N, 38;2;R;G;B, 48;5;N, 48;2;R;G;B.
Reset cur_fg / cur_bg / cur_attr to the boot defaults.
Resolve an xterm 256-colour palette index to a 0xRRGGBB triplet.
